item.title: Thrust Flight Opens Fort Worth Campus at Spinks Airport for Pilot and Aircraft Mechanic Training
item.description: Thrust Flight has opened a new aviation training campus at Spinks Airport in Fort Worth, offering accelerated pilot training and aircraft mechanic programs for students across North Texas.

item.title: Fort Worth’s Distribution Solutions Group Acquires Eastern Valve in Canada Expansion
item.description: The Fort Worth-based specialty distributor adds Atlantic Canada valve supplier Eastern Valve & Control Specialties, a company generating about CAD$17 million in annual revenue.

item.title: UNT Health, Weatherford College Launch Accelerated Pathway to Medical School
item.description: UNT Health’s Texas College of Osteopathic Medicine and Weatherford College have launched a new seven-year pathway program designed to help students become physicians faster while addressing critical primary care shortages in rural Texas.

item.title: Fort Worth’s Architectural Fabrication Appoints Ty Jackson To Lead National Architectural Programs
item.description: Building-materials veteran with more than 20 years of experience will lead national representation of Armetco Systems and Alumination.

item.title: Mercedes-Benz Financial Services to Add 120+ Jobs at AllianceTexas HQ in Fort Worth
item.description: Mercedes-Benz Financial Services USA will add more than 120 jobs to its Fort Worth headquarters at AllianceTexas as the company consolidates roles and expands operations.

item.title: True Grit, Neat — Point Blank Tequila Is Making Its Mark in Texas
item.description: An Aledo-based tequila brand with deep roots in the agave fields of Jalisco lands a major distribution deal with Total Wine while building a reputation as a maverick, namely due to its authenticity and craftsmanship.

item.title: TXO Partners’ Cross Timbers Venture To Sell $200M in Oil and Gas Assets
item.description: Fort Worth-based TXO expects about $100 million from the sale as it sharpens focus on core basins and prepares to pay down part of a prior acquisition.

item.title: Rising Data Center Demand May Add to Inflation Through Higher Energy Costs
item.description: Although the study describes the estimates as tentative, it represents one of the first attempts to quantify the potential inflation effects of the fast-growing data center industry.

item.title: Fort Worth’s Dana Burghdoff Earns Planning Profession’s Highest Honor
item.description: Fort Worth’s assistant city manager named to the 2026 class of Fellows of the American Institute of Certified Planners.

item.title: UNT Health Fort Worth Launches No-Cost Forensic Nursing Microcredential To Expand Care for Assault Survivors
item.description: The program, funded by a $1.5 million federal grant, aims to strengthen the forensic nursing workforce across Texas.
